guide.title: How to use Quick Memo
guide.description: Capture anything instantly with zero friction. Organize and convert to TODOs whenever you're ready.

capture.title: Capture instantly
capture.body: Long-press the logo or use the keyboard shortcut to open a capture popup anytime. Organize later.

steps.step1: Long-press the logo or press Ctrl+Shift+M to open the popup
steps.step2: Type your thought in one line and press save

organize.title: Organize your memos
organize.body: Convert memos to TODOs or archive them to keep things tidy. Aim to organize before hitting 500.

steps.step1: Check the 'Unsorted' tab for your memo list
steps.step2: Click the checkmark to promote to TODO, or the inbox icon to archive
steps.step3: Click a title to edit it inline

search.title: Search your memos
search.body: Find past memos instantly with keyword search.

steps.step1: Type a keyword in the search bar at the top
steps.step3: Click a memo to view or edit details
